caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden high chair placed centrally on a plain, light-colored background with no additional objects present. The chair features four tall, turned legs, with the two front legs being more detailed and cylindrical, and the two back legs being straight and slightly slanted. The legs are connected at the bottom by horizontal supports, with an additional support at a higher level functioning as a footrest. The seat is square-shaped and appears to be woven with a lighter material, possibly cane or rattan, providing contrast to the medium-brown wooden frame. The chair has curved armrests that extend from the backrest, which is curved and supported by vertical rods. The wood has a washed, slightly weathered appearance, and there are no additional decorations. The background remains unadorned except for a small signature in the lower right corner reading "michael chomyk" and a faint, small stain toward the upper center of the page.
title: Child's High Chair
